measures.name: Condition
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at]) RETURN CALCULATE(MIN('RealTimeData'[weather_desc]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t), "—")

measures.name: Temp Card
measures.expression: VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[temperature_2m]), AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[temperature_2m_f])) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.0") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", " °C", " °F")

measures.name: Wind Card
measures.expression: VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[wind_speed_10m]), AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[wind_speed_10m_mph])) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.0") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", " km/h", " mph")

measures.name: City Lat
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('RealTimeData'[location]), "Denver",39.73915, "Colorado Springs",38.83388, "Pueblo",38.25445, "Leadville",39.25082, "Fort Collins",40.58526, "Durango",37.27528, "Grand Junction",39.06387, "Glenwood Springs",39.55054, "Steamboat Springs",40.48498, "Castle Rock",39.27, "Longmont",40.27, "Boulder",40.06, "Trinidad",37.16946, "Sterling",40.62554, "Dinosaur",40.24358, "Cortez",37.34888, "Walsh",37.38613)

measures.name: City Long
